title: Titan X Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Strawberry Raspberry Cherry is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This convenient refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, delivering consistent, flavour-rich vaping without the need for manual refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. This vibrant mixed berry blend fuses the soft, juicy sweetness of Strawberry with the tangy brightness of Raspberry and the rich depth of Cherry. Each puff offers a dynamic, well-rounded flavour experience, enhanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Fitted with a pre-installed mesh coil for enhanced flavour and vapour, the Titan X Refill Kit works effortlessly with the Titan X’s smart auto-refill system to deliver up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent), offering great value and everyday convenience.
